record_title: Exact entropy-rectangle minimization and gauge dependence of ELCD corner selection
provenance: Analytic correction and invariance analysis of the entropy-based interface-state construction in arXiv:2609.19838.
limitations: The result corrects the stated continuous density-pressure rectangle minimization but does not show that the published ELCD experiments fail. An exact entropy minimizer does not determine velocity components, so it is not by itself a complete replacement interface-state algorithm. The closed form is for the ideal-gas entropy used in the source; no floating-point, near-vacuum, or empirical performance theorem is claimed. Originality is to the best of our knowledge.
